title: Schools of art: more on styles, Amaravati, context

boxes.title: Origin & trade: added
items: Andhra: symbol worship (==**Chaitika Vada**==) introduced by **Mahadeva**
Amaravati **Ayakapatas** show Buddha through symbols; stupa also a symbol
Gupta phase of Mathura: **standing** Buddhas prominent; **Manukwar** seated Buddha = Gupta tranquility
Trade evidence: **Periplus**, **Arikamedu**; Kushana trade via **Persian Bay**, **Red Sea**
Gandhara based on ==**Indo-Greek** style==; Kanishka protected it; = **Greco-Buddhist** art

boxes.title: Styles: added detail
items: Gandhara: Pakistan/Afghanistan; **Avalokiteshvara**, **Maitreya** with Buddha; spiritual calm
Mathura: **not restricted to Buddhism**; Shiva, Vishnu, **Surya**; Yaksha-Yakshi
Mathura began under the ==**Shungas**== (some notes); Gupta phase: elegance, softness
Amaravati: **Palnadu** limestone ("white marble"); Buddha on lotus in **Padmasana**
Amaravati: city life precise; **Yakshas**, **Gandharvas** dance around Buddha

boxes.title: Mudras & news
items: Abhaya: ==raised right palm==; Dhyana: hands in lap; Bhumisparsha: earth witness against **Mara**
Dharmachakra common in Gupta Sarnath images
